text: ひでんマシンは　つかっても　なくならない　タイプ　ぜんぶで　７しゅるい　あります　…　シルフ　カンパニー

structure.jp: つかっても　なくならない　タイプ
structure.en: are the type that doesn't run out even when used

structure.jp: ぜんぶで　７しゅるい　あります
…　シルフ　カンパニー

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: The て ending plus も means 'even if' or 'even when'. つかっても = 'even when you use it'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つかっても　なくならない　タイプ
patterns.explanation: A short sentence placed right before a thing describes that thing, like 'that' or 'which' in English. つかっても　なくならない　タイプ = 'the type that doesn't run out even when used'.

patterns.name: 〜で (total)
patterns.explanation: で after an amount word shows the total being counted up. ぜんぶで = 'in all'.
